description:
Escape Velocity Classic
The Confederation, the Rebellion and the ships of Ambrosia's Escape Velocity (1996), brought to the Persean Sector.

EscapeVelocityClassic-0.5.1.zip on GitHub

The Ships

Spoiler

Requires: Starsector 0.98a. A new game is required.
Optional: Nexerelin (both factions are playable, with EV starting fleets; random sectors are supported).

What's in it

Two small factions: the Confederation and the Rebellion. They start at war.
16 hulls and 4 fighter wings from EV, most with new starsector-style art: Confederate Cruiser, Superfrigate and Gunboat; Rebel Cruiser, Destroyer and Escort Carrier; and the shared civilian hulls (Kestrel, Corvette, Rapier, Argosy, Clipper, Defender, freighters and tankers).
7 weapons with their original EV firing sounds: Laser Cannon, Proton Cannon, Neutron Blaster, Mass Driver, Missile Rack, Heavy Rocket Launcher and Torpedo Launcher. As in EV, the Laser and Proton Cannons get bonus range when mounted in a fixed hardpoint.
Three star systems: Antares (New Providence, Luna, Ruby, the Confederate home), Satori (Palshife, the Rebel capital) and Levo (neutral ground: an independent water world and the pirate station Blackthorne).

Design notes

EV ships carry far fewer mounts than Starsector ships, so the hulls are priced by what they carry: fewer guns means a lower deployment cost, with tougher hulls and better flux. The EV guns are "heavy" guns that cost more OP, but they are balanced per OP against vanilla, so they are fair on any ship.
EV faction fleets are about 75-80% EV ships, plus vanilla hulls (the Confederation uses high-tech and midline; the Rebellion uses low-tech and midline). NPC EV ships always fly their EV loadouts.
Faction-exclusive hulls, the Neutron Blaster, the Mass Driver and the faction fighter LPCs are sold only in their faction's military markets. Levo's markets mostly sell shared EV hulls.
Every EV ship, weapon and wing drops as its own rare blueprint.

Known issues / to do

Balance is early. Feedback on ship matchups is very welcome.
Add iconic hullmods from EV like Mass Expansion and Tritanium Armor
Override? Nova? maybe if enough people ask

Credits
Escape Velocity was created by Matt Burch and published by Ambrosia Software. This is a free, non-commercial fan mod, not affiliated with or endorsed by Ambrosia. EV names, ship designs, the remaining original sprites and the weapon sounds belong to their original creators.

AI disclaimer

Spoiler
Ship art: Gemini Argon - Original sprites from EV were fed into and modified into starsector style.
Code: Claude (Anthropic's AI) code under my direction. I set the design goals, tested in-game and made the balance calls.

Changelog
0.5.1 - Hotfix New Providence market to have +1 industry slot and prevent it stuck at 0 stability.
0.5.0 - First public release.
